model.graph: two-site target edge and four-site square face, with all bonds in each finite volume
model.observable: A_2=exp(i*character_amplitude*(q_0+q_1)/hbar), supported on the first two sites
model.reference: rho=Z^(-1) exp(-beta H) from the uncut finite Q3 Hamiltonian
model.cutoff: replace only bond coordinates by the smooth cosine cutoff q_L; W_L=H-H_L
model.direct_difference: D_sigma(t)=exp(-it(H+sigma W_L)/hbar) A_2 exp(+it(H+sigma W_L)/hbar)-exp(-itH/hbar) A_2 exp(+itH/hbar)
model.modular_difference: delta D_sigma=[-beta H,D_sigma] in the finite Gibbs representation

no_overclaim: This is a finite two-site local-observable direct-D and modular-derivative scaling diagnostic. It does not prove a volume/source/cutoff/beta-uniform Cauchy theorem, a common dynamics, OS/KMS/GNS identification, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.
